title: PlaneMem workbench session registry and current state
description: Full sessions/session operation models for POST /v1/workbench/query. Registry and current-state envelopes differ; current state is not an original command receipt. Load session-activity-read and session-resume resources and their local dependencies.
$comment: Runtime additionally checks UTF-16/lone-surrogate limits, real dates, exact scope/trace, parent inequality, unique and strictly ordered rows, query/continuation relationships and serialized byte budget. Closed schemas model normalized wire outputs; generic JS parser inputs are not universally ordinary-JSON snapshots. No validator/generator/runtime evidence.

queryText.description: Raw<=500 UTF-16 units, no controls/DEL/lone surrogate; trim and omit if blank. Client_id instead preserves leading/trailing whitespace when nonblank.

time.description: Exact six-digit UTC microseconds, real calendar checked by millisecond prefix roundtrip. Never rebuild from displayed milliseconds.

query.description: Raw fields without operation; null rejected. Empty status/client_id omitted, query trimmed/omitted, limit defaults25 at read time without inserting a field. Cursor fully parsed/canonically re-encoded even before dispatch. No dedicated8KiB query snapshot in this parser.

normalizedQuery.description: Effective captured query; optional limit remains absent when omitted. Not echoed in the registry envelope.

record.description: Complete 14-field normalized record. Parent must differ from own session_id, but can be nonnull without resume_origin; no invented legacy origin. Ended/abandoned/failed require canonical millisecond ended_at; running/paused require null. No started<=ended rule. Current latest checkpoint is independent of the original resume checkpoint; IDs may coincide or differ. Saved actor/client/trace are not current caller identity.

scope.description: Registry parser requires nonblank bounded text and exact captured scope; does not independently require ULIDs.

metadata.description: Gateway identity present iff authenticated_client===true, even when write_sessions=false. write_sessions additionally requires admin/session.write; hints do not grant subsequent mutation authority. Registry parser compares identity scope, not actor/client against original SDK context.

pageFields.description: Unique session IDs, data.length<=effective limit; strict started_at DESC/session_id ASC after input cursor. status/client_id membership checked, text query not independently recomputed. has_more=true requires full page and next position==last row with unchanged input key; false forbids continuation. No total or frozen snapshot.

page.description: Normalized page. Shared JS page parser also tolerates other input properties before reconstructing this shape, but counts the complete supplied object's serialized bytes.

envelope.description: Complete normalized Gateway/SDK envelope; current trace/scope exactly checked. Four sources ordered and closed; identity scope matches scope. Full JSON.stringify/UTF8 size<=2MiB is checked by page parser on the whole envelope after metadata reads. Unlike context directory, no common finite ordinary-JSON/depth/node snapshot is used for a custom transport.

stateEnvelope.description: Actual POST operation=session output; no outer tenant/workspace/project or scope/query echo, no dedicated registry2MiB parser. source_refs[0].id and data.session_id equal requested session. The separate GET /v1/sessions/{id} adds outer scope and uses SessionStateEnvelope, so the two envelopes are not interchangeable.

cursorContent.description: Canonical compact ASCII JSON unpadded base64url [1,key,started_at,session_id]. SHA256 key hashes session-registry-v1/scope/restricted/query/status/client_id/limit. Changing limit requires restart; trace/actor/client caller identity not bound. Current authorization still reapplied.

x-runtime-boundaries.http: Authenticated generic workbench POST, context.read Policy/audit, optional expected actor/client header checks, no mandatory verified-client gate for these reads. Pre-auth1MiB JSON, traceparent before x-trace-id, generic actor/path limiter. No dedicated URL-query/media/encoding/cache-condition rejection or write preconditions; generic success cache bypassed. No dedicated two-slot handler or whole server response deadline.
x-runtime-boundaries.registryDatabase: Single statement selects scoped visible-parent sessions with all filters/position before MATERIALIZED LIMIT+1; hidden/missing parent yields empty200. Order started_at DESC/session_id COLLATE C. Query literal PostgreSQL lower/strpos across session/client/actor/trace, '%'/'_' not wildcards. Status/client equality uses SQL default equality, not an explicit C clause. Count runs/tools only for candidates by global session foreign key; latest checkpoint also checks full scope and revision DESC. Only selected limit records fully parsed, lookahead indicates existence.
x-runtime-boundaries.numericAndTime: Registry version/count/checkpoint revision read as canonical nonnegative decimal text and converted only if safe integer; version/checkpoint revision further positive. started_at uses six-digit UTC microseconds, ended_at three-digit UTC milliseconds. Does not infer elapsed duration or verify resume origin against live handoff/checkpoint.2MiB JSON check after database/materialization does not bound earlier allocation, query duration or count cost.
x-runtime-boundaries.currentState: Single scoped visible-parent state query, absent/hidden session404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND; malformed state500 SESSION_ACTIVITY_INVALID. Converts version with Number then positive-safe validation, unlike registry canonical decimal check. Metadata added by workbench handler with no full registry-envelope parse. Current state does not prove original finish/resume success; no original receipt lookup or writes.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk: listSessions normalizes query and copies request context before default30s per-request budget; finite captured query returned but no own-data/8KiB snapshot requirement in this helper. Custom transport receives complete envelope parsing and post-parse deadline check, with plain JSON.stringify byte bound but no generalized depth/node/prototype/getter rejection. Fetch bounded-json separately includes credentials/network/body, success2MiB/error16KiB, exact200/trace/media/fatalUTF8/content-length. No automatic pagination/retry/save. getSessionState instead uses the dedicated GET and its existing ordinary JSON envelope path, not this POST session model.
x-runtime-boundaries.errors: INVALID_INPUT400 false, SESSION_NOT_FOUND404 false, SESSION_REGISTRY_INVALID/SESSION_ACTIVITY_INVALID500 false; generic authentication/policy401/403, RATE_LIMITED429 true, WORKBENCH_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE/WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 true and INTERNAL_ERROR500 true. SDK registry sanitizes only known same-trace codes to retryable=false; WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE is absent from its whitelist and becomes GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE.
x-runtime-boundaries.remaining: Schema resources are development artifacts. Existing SDK/CLI/MCP/Web consumers use hand-written parsers; no machine-schema integration, generated clients, Mock registry migration, database index execution or runtime compatibility evidence claimed.
